description: Live calendars: works on the real calendars people connected to the app. Creates a new event on an account's calendar. Which calendar: if the person has more than one calendar account (in list_accounts, leaving out Zoom accounts) and hasn't said which one to use, ask them which before calling this, unless you were told their default calendar. If the person hasn't said how long the event is, ask them, unless you were told a default length, and set endsAt from startsAt and that length. It can invite attendees, who receive invitations, and add a video meeting: meet on a Google calendar, teams on an Outlook calendar, or zoom on any calendar with zoomAccountId, a connected Zoom account from list_accounts. If the person has more than one Zoom account and hasn't said which, ask them which. Pyas calendars (the sandbox's people) take zoom only. To change an event that already exists, including adding a video meeting to it, use update_event: a new event sends attendees a second invitation.

accountId.description: A Pyas account ID (list_accounts returns them).

endsAt.description: An ISO 8601 date and time, e.g. 2026-10-21T15:00:00Z (or with an offset).

meeting.description: Add a video meeting: meet (Google calendars), teams (Outlook calendars) or zoom (with zoomAccountId).

startsAt.description: An ISO 8601 date and time, e.g. 2026-10-21T15:00:00Z (or with an offset).

timezone.description: IANA time zone, for example America/New_York (default: the calendar's time zone).

zoomAccountId.description: For zoom: the connected Zoom account to make the meeting with (provider zoom in list_accounts).

name: create_event
title: Create an event
